# Is your acreage worth more as fruit or as your own wine?

> Free vineyard calculator: compare selling your grapes by the ton with bottling and selling your own wine. Break-even sell-through, bottle price, grape price and acreage. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages
